# VARGERSOFT

> VARGERSOFT is the software division of VARGER Group LLC (Conroe, Texas, USA). It builds bilingual (English/Spanish) AI agents, apps and AI-ready websites for small and mid-size businesses, at fixed prices. Contact: sales@vargersoft.com.

Prices in USD. AI agents are set up in 7 business days and billed month to month. A Spanish version of every page is under /es/.

## AI agents and services

- [AI Agents for Small and Mid-Size Businesses](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/): Eight AI services that answer calls and chats, book appointments, send quotes, follow up and make your business readable to AI. English and Spanish. Prices on the page.
- [AI Phone Receptionist for Small Business](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/ai-receptionist/): A natural-sounding AI receptionist that answers every call in English or Spanish, books appointments and takes messages. $1,950 setup + $349/month.
- [Website AI Assistant and Chatbot](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/website-assistant/): An AI chat assistant for your website that answers questions, captures leads and books appointments in English and Spanish. $850 setup + $179/month.
- [AI Appointment Scheduling Agent](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/appointment-agent/): An AI agent that books, confirms and reschedules appointments by phone and text in English and Spanish. $1,450 setup + $249/month.
- [AI Quote and Lead Follow-up Agent](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/quote-follow-up-agent/): An AI agent that answers SMS and WhatsApp, sends quotes and follows up with every lead in English and Spanish. $2,450 setup + $399/month.
- [AI Payment Reminder Agent](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/collections-agent/): An AI agent that sends polite, scheduled payment reminders to your own customers by voice, text and email. $1,250 setup + $229/month.
- [AI-Ready Website Design and Updates](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/ai-ready-websites/): We build or update your website so Google, ChatGPT and other AI assistants can read every page: fast, bilingual and structured. New site $2,450, update $1,250.
- [AI Visibility: GEO and AEO Services](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/ai-visibility/): GEO and AEO for small business: structured data, answer-ready content and monthly tracking so AI assistants can read and cite you. $1,500 setup + $299/month.
- [Agent-Ready Websites: MCP and WebMCP Setup](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/agent-ready-websites/): We prepare your website for AI agents: an MCP server for your catalog and bookings, WebMCP tools on your pages and clean machine-readable data. $1,950 setup + $199/month.
- [Start your AI receptionist](https://www.vargersoft.com/ai/start/): Tell us about your business in 5 minutes. We build your bilingual AI receptionist, you test it, then we connect it to your phone.

## Apps built by VARGERSOFT

- [DERATE](https://www.derate.app): Photograph a truck dashboard or scanner and get the fault code cause, urgency and estimated cost.
- [Paternoster](https://praypaternoster.com): Pray and listen to the Our Father in five languages, with words that light up as they are spoken.
- [Fresh or Toss](https://freshortoss.app): Search any of 695 foods and see how long it lasts in the fridge, freezer or pantry, with a reminder before it runs out.
- [CaseAlerta](https://casealerta.com): Plain-Spanish explanations of your USCIS case status, with alerts when it changes.
- [Recalert](https://recalert.us): Product recall lookup and nightly inventory checks for U.S. businesses, across CPSC, FSIS, NHTSA and FDA.
- [SignatureForever](https://signatureforever.com): A polished email signature in about two minutes that looks the same in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail.
- [Scorlee](https://scorlee.com): Shows renters how many months of rent could count toward their credit. No SSN or bank needed to start.
- [BajaBill](https://bajabill.com): AI review of hospital bills for overcharges, in Spanish and English, for Latino families in the U.S.

## Guides

- [Resources: Plain Guides on AI for Business](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/): Plain-language guides on AI receptionists, SEO, AEO and GEO, llms.txt, MCP and WebMCP, and what a small business should automate first.
- [How much does an AI receptionist cost for a small business?](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/ai-receptionist-cost-small-business/): What you pay for an AI phone receptionist: setup, monthly fee and minutes, with VARGERSOFT prices and the questions to ask any provider.
- [AI receptionist vs. answering service vs. hiring: which fits?](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/ai-receptionist-vs-answering-service-vs-hiring/): A plain comparison of an AI receptionist, a live answering service and a hired receptionist: hours, languages, what each handles well and where each falls short.
- [How to answer business calls in English and Spanish without hiring](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/answer-business-calls-in-english-and-spanish/): Four ways a small business can answer callers in English and Spanish, from a phone menu to an AI receptionist that detects the language on its own.
- [SEO vs. AEO vs. GEO: what each one means](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/seo-vs-aeo-vs-geo/): SEO, AEO and GEO explained in plain words: what each one optimizes for, how they overlap and what a small business should do first.
- [What is llms.txt, and does your website need it?](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/what-is-llms-txt/): llms.txt explained honestly: what the file is, who proposed it, what the 2026 evidence says about AI crawlers using it, and what matters more.
- [What are MCP and WebMCP, in plain words?](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/what-is-mcp-and-webmcp/): MCP and WebMCP explained for business owners: what each one does, how they differ, what works today and what is still an early draft.
- [How to prepare your website for AI agents](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/how-to-prepare-your-website-for-ai-agents/): A practical checklist to make a business website usable by AI assistants and agents: readable pages, structured data, open crawler rules and clear actions.
- [What should a small business automate first?](https://www.vargersoft.com/resources/what-to-automate-first-in-a-small-business/): How to choose the first process to automate in a small business: find the repeated task that costs customers, fix the process, then automate and measure.
